Run multi-omics factor analysis pipeline

Source: R/pipeline.R
run_factor_pipeline.Rd

Runs one or more latent factor methods on a (list of) numeric matrix/matrices and returns scores and loadings in a single, unified format, so that any downstream function (benchmarking, embeddings, clustering, plots) works the same way whatever method produced the factors.

Usage

run_factor_pipeline(
  X,
  methods = c("FABIA", "MOFA", "GFA", "MFA"),
  k = 10,
  scale_features = TRUE,
  mfa_group_sizes = NULL,
  fabia_alpha = 0.01,
  fabia_cyc = 1000,
  mofa_outfile = file.path(tempdir(), "mofa_model.hdf5"),
  mofa_convergence = "slow",
  mofa_maxiter = 2000,
  mofa_use_basilisk = FALSE,
  mofa_python = NULL,
  gfa_iter_burnin = 500,
  gfa_iter_max = 1000,
  pca_block_weight = TRUE,
  sgcca_keep = NULL,
  jive_rank_individual = 1,
  rabfa_graph = NULL,
  rabfa_iter = 2000,
  rabfa_burnin = 1000,
  rabfa_control = list(),
  seed = 21,
  verbose = TRUE,
  stop_on_error = FALSE
)

Arguments

X

Either a single numeric matrix (features x samples) or a named list of such matrices. All matrices must share the same sample names (column names).

methods

Character vector of method names to run, case-insensitive. Any subset of c("PCA", "MFA", "FABIA", "GFA", "MOFA", "SGCCA", "JIVE", "RABFA"); see list_factor_methods(). Defaults to c("FABIA", "MOFA", "GFA", "MFA").

k

Integer. Target number of latent factors (default 10).

scale_features

Logical. If TRUE (default), each feature is z-scored before fitting. Features with zero variance become 0.

mfa_group_sizes

Integer vector. Column group sizes passed to FactoMineR::MFA(). If NULL (default), derived from view sizes.

fabia_alpha

Numeric. Sparseness parameter for FABIA (default 0.01).

fabia_cyc

Integer. Number of FABIA cycles (default 1000).

mofa_outfile

Character. Path for the MOFA2 HDF5 output file. Defaults to a file in tempdir().

mofa_convergence

Character. Convergence mode for MOFA2: "fast", "medium", or "slow" (default "slow").

mofa_maxiter

Integer. Maximum MOFA2 iterations (default 2000).

mofa_use_basilisk

Logical. Let MOFA2 install its own Python environment through basilisk (default FALSE, i.e. use the Python found by reticulate, which must have mofapy2 installed).

mofa_python

Optional path to the Python binary that has mofapy2 installed; passed to reticulate::use_python() before MOFA2 runs.

gfa_iter_burnin

Integer. GFA burn-in iterations (default 500).

gfa_iter_max

Integer. GFA maximum iterations (default 1000).

pca_block_weight

Logical. For "PCA", divide each view by the square root of its number of features so that large views do not dominate (default TRUE).

sgcca_keep

Optional integer vector (one value per view) giving the number of features kept per component in SGCCA. NULL (default) keeps all features (no sparsity).

jive_rank_individual

Integer. Rank of each view's individual structure for JIVE (default 1).

rabfa_graph

Optional feature graph for RABFA (edge data frame, adjacency matrix, or per-view list); see rabfa() and build_feature_graph(). NULL (default) fits RABFA without a graph.

rabfa_iter, rabfa_burnin

Total MCMC iterations and burn-in for RABFA (defaults 2000 and 1000).

rabfa_control

List of RABFA hyperparameters; see rabfa_control().

seed

Integer. Random seed (default 21).

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages (default TRUE).

stop_on_error

Logical. If FALSE (default) a method that fails is skipped with a warning and the other methods are still returned.

Value

A named list of class factomics_results, with one entry per fitted method. Each entry contains:

scores

Matrix of sample factor scores (samples x k).

loadings

Matrix of feature loadings (features x k). Row names use "view::feature" notation.

meta

Method-specific metadata (number of factors, settings, etc.).

plots

(MOFA only) List of diagnostic ggplot objects.

The preprocessed views are kept in attr(x, "views") and are used by variance_explained() and embed_results().

Examples

sim <- simulate_multiomics(n_samples = 40, seed = 1)
res <- run_factor_pipeline(sim$data, methods = c("PCA", "MFA"), k = 3,
                           verbose = FALSE)
res
#> <factomics_results>
#>   40 samples, 3 view(s): transcriptome (200), metabolome (80), microbiome (50)
#>   PCA    3 factors
#>   MFA    3 factors
head(res$MFA$scores)
#>              F1         F2         F3
#> S001 -1.6155192  0.7839443  0.4786979
#> S002 -0.1738509 -1.9503153  0.2820183
#> S003  2.6580348  0.3970507 -0.3917322
#> S004 -3.4817133  1.2120201  1.0907031
#> S005  0.2965065 -1.4153488 -0.9479438
#> S006  2.7317508  1.1183909  1.1629432
